title: Bride of A Dragon
synopsis: Princess Isobel is sold to King Daemon, the ruthless Dragon King whose brides were burned to death on their wedding night, by the uncle who murdered her parents and stole her throne. To survive, she must seduce the monster, master the forbidden magic, and take back everything that was stolen from her.

title: Sarah's Accidental Vows
synopsis: Sarah Porter returns to Great Band City after six years abroad. She aims to reclaim her place in the design industry and confront her past, including unresolved issues with her old flame Elliot Brook.

title: Gone With His Triplets
synopsis: Kelly Adler navigates complex personal and professional challenges. She confronts her estranged husband Jacob, seeks to finalize their divorce, and balances her role as a single mother of triplets, while excelling in her career at Rising Sun Tech.

title: Rekindled Heartache
synopsis: Zoey thought she'd buried the past, but Blaine's return tears open old wounds. As they clash over love, betrayal, and her son's life, buried secrets resurface with devastating force. She's forced to choose: her pride or his help.

title: Alpha's Obsession
synopsis: Lycan, Alpha of the most powerful pack, has always rejected political mates, until he meets Selene, a broken Omega with a hidden power. As he protects her from ruthless rivals, their fated bond begins to challenge the very laws of the werewolf world.

title: Badla
synopsis: Prithvi Preemal, billionaire owner of a Rs 1000 crore tech company, has worked at Singla Group as an ordinary employee for five years, and a marriage promise was made before either of them was born. The story frames corporate revenge, corporate politics, secrets, identity, and the marriage promise.

title: Fake Wife
synopsis: Dev is trapped in a fake marriage and is doing everything to make it real; Riya dismisses him and his love. With rival Avinash's return and a truth that risks destroying everything, the story asks whether their fake relationship can survive as real feelings unfold.

title: Final Bliss
synopsis: A wealthy Sikh businessman receives an ultimatum from his child: if he does not marry within two months, the son will take his rightful place in the company. He disguises himself as a washing machine salesman and meets Mahima; a test of whether love can exist without money turns genuine.

title: Meri Sanki Dulhaniya
synopsis: When a bride refuses to take no for an answer, obsession and emotional blackmail take over. Sheetal, a powerful MD, decides Raj will marry her; his refusal turns his life upside down, and the story asks whether this is love, madness, or revenge.

title: Love Under Arrest
synopsis: A grand wedding celebration quickly turns into chaos when the groom's mother collapses during the baraat. Before the night is over, Radhika finds herself in a dark interrogation room in full bridal clothes, answering questions about a marriage she barely understood. The description lists themes of domestic abuse, emotional betrayal, forced marriage, and hidden truth.

title: Love, Lost & Found
synopsis: Ek fake relationship se shuru hui kahani… par dil asli takra gaye. Dimag bhool gaya, par pyaar nahi.

title: Mehmaan ya Shaitaan
synopsis: Ek raat, ek anjaan mehmaan… aur har minute badalta sach. Dhokha kisne diya?

title: Khoon Ka Rishta
synopsis: Woh akeli thi, par haar maani nahi… Ab kismat uske samne usi aadmi ko le aayi, jise woh bhool chuki thi.

title: Forbidden Love
synopsis: Umar ke hisaab se nahi, dil ke jazbaat se likhi gayi hai yeh kahani. Pyaar 20 saal chhota nahi, bas thoda alag hai.

title: Billionaire CEO ka Raaz
synopsis: Yeh sirf pyaar aur badla nahi… ek deadly game hai. Iss 5 million ki deal mein har move mehenga padega.

title: Love Is A Dangerous Game
synopsis: When the heiress's father died, her uncles seized the family company and fortune, leaving the siblings in misery. But everything changed when the heiress met a mysterious boss. In order to exact revenge on those who harmed her family, she disguised herself as a naive girl and lurked beside them, uncovering long-buried truths. What she didn't know was that the person she trusted most was quietly helping her—this mysterious boss was actually her father's benefactor...

title: The Mafia Daddy's Little Bodyguard
synopsis: In a world of crime and power, an ex-Special Forces agent unexpectedly protects a mafia boss. When she discovers his hidden identity and past, the line between protection and love becomes blurry. Will she escape the Mafia or fall for the Mafia daddy? Don't miss it!

title: He Stole My Body and Regretted It
original_title: He Stole My Body and Regretted It
synopsis: When her wedding is shattered by her fiancé's betrayal, she wakes up in a stranger's body. To uncover the truth, she must navigate a new identity and confront a world of secrets, lies, and forbidden love. But every step closer to the truth only deepens the mystery—and the danger.

title: Cinderella's Dragon Prince
synopsis: After her father dies, Arya, eldest Winde daughter, is abused by stepmother Vera and stepsisters. Black Dragon Prince Damian is forced to choose a bride, so a ball is held and everyone wants to attend. Vera schemes for a daughter to be chosen. Unknown to her, Damian already disguised himself as a commoner, entered the estate, and fell for Arya after a passionate back-alley kiss. At the ball, his true identity shocks everyone.

title: The Captain's Mermaid Bride
synopsis: At twenty-two, Elena was accepted into nursing school, but her family's dire financial straits forced her—via a lottery—into a contract marriage with Cole, a fishing boat captain rumored to be cold and stern. She discovered warmth in Cole's mother Margaret, and that Cole himself—though outwardly aloof—was a man of deep feeling. Her dormant mermaid lineage began to awaken, and the seashell pendant she had carried since infancy held the secret of her true origins. Cole worked tirelessly at sea to fund her return to school; she qualified as a nurse and opened a community clinic, and together they built a loving family while she embraced her destiny as a mermaid of the Tide-Folk.

title: Hidden Ace Saves Them All
synopsis: After her parents died, Ruby grew up in a military base with her brother. Her mother left her a necklace to keep her safe, and she became a special agent for a mission. She infiltrated the base to find a secret code and discovered the truth about her parents' death. She then returned to her family and found out that her brother was actually her enemy's son.

title: My Fry Cook Mom is the Hidden Mafia Queen
original_title: My Fry Cook Mom is the Hidden Mafia Queen
synopsis: When her daughter is critically injured by a Mafia heir, a former Mafia godmother comes out of hiding. As the feared Black Widow, she single-handedly takes on an entire corrupt power network.

title: My Cursed Merman Husband Rules the Deep
original_title: My Cursed Merman Husband Rules the Deep
synopsis: In the underwater kingdom, Merletta, a mermaid princess, loses her voice to save Prince Thalassor from the evil sea witch. Now, torn between saving his kingdom from the sea witch's curse and being trapped on land forever, she must convince Thalassor to claim her as his chosen wife before time runs out. Will their love break the curse?

title: Copycat
synopsis: When Yvonne's beloved sister was murdered and her face was stolen by the killer, she assumed her sister's identity and infiltrated the mansion of the woman who ruined her family. What started as a mission for revenge soon became an even bigger game when her husband's rival and protector became involved. As Yvonne delves deeper into her sister's world, will she find the killer before her real identity is exposed? Or will her desire for revenge consume her?

title: The Alpha's Forbidden Bunny
synopsis: In the beastkin world, Toby (a rabbit whose impending marriage was called off) is forced into an arranged marriage with Enzo (the wolf king and adoptive father of his former fiancee) following an unexpected one-night stand. Humiliated again and again by his ex and her family, Toby is saved by Enzo through crisis after crisis, and what begins as forced dependence slowly turns into helpless devotion — sparking a dangerous, forbidden romance defined by an extreme emotional tension.

title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands
original_title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands
synopsis: Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power. Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis's most unwanted woman to its most adored.

title: The Godfather's Heartbroken Lover
synopsis: Tara arrives in New York with a suitcase and a broken heart, running from the past that left her with nothing. Then fate intervenes — she's hired by the powerful Vincent Moretti, a man who has everything but love. As she heals from her pain, Vincent falls deeply for her. But will their love survive the dangerous world of the Mafia and the shadows of the past?

title: The Mafia Bride Who Never Showed Up
original_title: The Mafia Bride Who Never Showed Up
synopsis: Mafia heiress Nora, always second to her cousin Selena, finally snaps. Adrian forgets her allergy, her gifts, her existence—yet remembers everything about Selena. Done being invisible, Nora accepts Julian Vale, a stronger heir who keeps every promise Adrian broke. Adrian learns too late: the bride never showed up—she chose her own life instead.

title: Left at the Altar, Married to the Mafia
original_title: Left at the Altar, Married to the Mafia
synopsis: Left at the altar by her fiancé, Mia runs from her wedding to a biker bar, only to be saved by the mysterious mafia king Dominic. With no choice but to marry Dominic, Mia must face a world of danger and desire. Can she trust Dominic to save her? Or will she be dragged into the treacherous world of the Mafia?

title: Married to the Mafia Don,His Autistic Daughter Calls Me Mommy
original_title: Married to the Mafia Don,His Autistic Daughter Calls Me Mommy
synopsis: To pay her family's debt, Vivian is given in marriage to mafia boss Dante and becomes the stepmother of his autistic daughter Stella. In the treacherous mansion, she fights Camilla's plots and protects abused Stella. Their transactional marriage blooms into genuine love. Vivian heals the girl and finds her own warm family.
